parameters.name: EffectiveOrNot
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query for prepaid cards that are in effect. Valid values: `true` and `false`.

parameters.name: ExpiryTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end of the expiration time range to query. The format is `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

parameters.name: ExpiryTimeStart
parameters.description: The start of the expiration time range to query. The format is `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.
